title: docs(skills): objectstack-i18n teaches the action preflight.fields translation key
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x1YMmBhmKb6adYxNbKbCkrC)_

Fixes #31925

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

`dispatch-gates --tier` reads a contract-review model mandate for `skills/**` (clause ①). That mandate is waived by the maintainer's standing order in this project (2026-11-03). This card ran on the project's default model, and the dispatching seat (domain:skills#3) runs the contract review.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 的 `_actions.{action_name}` 行在 `resultDialog.fields.{path}` 旁加上 `preflight.fields.{path}`;`translation-target-unknown` 段落加上"未声明的 `preflight.fields` 路径"。
- 教的内容全部按 `main` 上的 schema(`translation.zod.ts`)、lint(`validate-translation-references.ts`)和控制台读取器(`useObjectLabel.ts`)核对过,并用 `tsx` 探针实测了解析结果。
- 和卡片的一处差别:`preflight.title` 是**解析时**被 `defineTranslationBundle` 拒绝(strict schema),不是 `os validate` 的 lint 拒绝。文中按 `main` 写。
- 评测:席位把改动面扩到 `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/*.json`(仅一个用例),新增用例 10:zh-CN 下 preflight 行标签仍是英文,答案按每个声明的字面 `path` 写 `preflight.fields`,不写 `preflight.title`。
- 字节:净增 86 token,文件 5763 → 5849,天花板 6333 不动(余量 484),不用删字也不用改棘轮。
- 需要你做的:`check-governed-merges` 判为 **Tier H**(`skills/**`),需 `os-zhuang` 或 `hotlong` 批准;当前 head 尚无席位契约复核 PASS,契约复核待做,请先不要批。

## The changed lines

`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`, the `_actions.{action_name}` row (L164), after `resultDialog.fields.{path}`:

```diff
-… `resultDialog.fields.{path}` (the literal `path` of a field in `resultDialog.fields[]`, dots included — `client.secret` is one key); the same keys hold under `globalActions.{action_name}` |
+… `resultDialog.fields.{path}` (the literal `path` of a field in `resultDialog.fields[]`, dots included — `client.secret` is one key), `preflight.fields.{path}` (only under an action that declares `preflight`: a field's literal `path` in its `preflight.fields[]`, its value a plain string as under `resultDialog.fields`; `defineTranslationBundle` refuses any other key under `preflight`, a `title` included); the same keys hold under `globalActions.{action_name}` |
```

The `translation-target-unknown` paragraph (L225–L228):

```diff
 that do. Three more shapes under an action entry are the error: an outcome the action does
-not declare in `outcomeMessages`; a `resultDialog.fields` path it does not declare; and
+not declare in `outcomeMessages`; a `resultDialog.fields` or `preflight.fields` path it does
+not declare (an action with no `preflight` declares none); and
 `resultDialog` `title` / `description` / `acknowledge` under an action that declares no
```

The `globalActions` half is not restated: the row's existing tail ("the same keys hold under `globalActions.{action_name}`") covers it. The count "Three" still holds: the preflight path joins the `resultDialog.fields` item rather than adding one.

## Each taught claim and its source on `main` (`7e8b31ce5`)

Every claim was also checked with a `tsx` probe that parses bundles through `TranslationDataSchema` from `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`, under both `objects.a._actions.b` and `globalActions.g`: `{ fields: { 'verdict.summary': '摘要' } }` parses; `{ title: 'X', fields: {} }` is refused with `Unrecognized key(s) on this action preflight translation: \`title\`` and the schema's guidance line; `{ fields: { a: { label: 'x' } } }` is refused with `expected string, received object`.

| Claim | Source on `main` |
|:--|:--|
| `preflight.fields.{path}` is a key under `_actions.{action_name}` | `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` L405 `preflight: ActionPreflightTranslationSchema.optional()`; convention docblock L307 |
| …and under `globalActions.{action_name}` (not restated; the row's tail says it) | same factory, L1211 convention `globalActions.<action_name>.preflight.fields.<path>` |
| Keyed by the field's literal `path`, dots included | L308–L312 (`"verdict.summary"`, "resolvers must index the record directly, not split on `.`"); console `ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts` L780–L781 "keyed by the LITERAL field path and fetched whole" |
| Its value is a plain string (no `.label`) | L328 `fields: z.record(z.string(), z.string())`; probe above |
| Any other key under `preflight`, a `title` included, is refused by `defineTranslationBundle` | strict object L321–L327, `title` guidance L324–L326; `defineTranslationBundle` L2594–L2595 parses `TranslationBundleSchema` (L2567, values `TranslationDataSchema`); probe above |
| Holds only under an action that declares `preflight` | console: `useObjectLabel.ts` L796 returns the spec untouched when there is no `preflight` with `fields`, and L781–L783 "only declared rows are overlaid"; lint: next row |
| A `preflight.fields` path the action does not declare is `translation-target-unknown` (an error) — also under an action with no `preflight`, or a `preflight` with no `fields` | `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` L3065–L3096 `checkActionPreflightFields` (severity `TRANSLATION_TARGET_UNKNOWN_SEVERITY`, three message variants L3083–L3092), called from `checkActionEntry` L2660; key table L2631 |
| The console reads the key | `packages/spec/liveness/action.json` L285 (`preflight` LIVE; "Each `fields` row's label reads the bundle key `…preflight.fields.PATH`"); `useObjectLabel.ts` L788–L803 `actionPreflight` |

**Card claims against `main`:** all hold, with one precision. The card says a `preflight.title` key is one "the bundle refuses" and puts it in "the refusal list" beside the `resultDialog.fields` path line. On `main` that refusal is the strict schema at parse (`defineTranslationBundle`), not the `os validate` lint that paragraph describes; the lint only judges `preflight.fields` paths. So the `title` refusal is taught in the row, naming `defineTranslationBundle`, and the lint paragraph gets only the path rule.

**What `os i18n check` / extract do with it:** `packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts` L827–L840 `pushActionPreflight` emits one `preflight.fields.<path>` entry per declared field (object actions L1522, global actions L1622), so coverage asks for them and extract scaffolds them. SKILL.md's coverage section (L308–L310, "every surface the extractor walks — objects and their sub-keys, global actions") already covers this; nothing added.

**`content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx`** (generated): L140, L245, L423, L663, L873 give the node's shape `{ fields?: Record<string, string> }` and "Translations for the action preflight panel". They do not say the key is the literal path, that it holds only under a declared `preflight`, or that `title` is refused, so the skill text is not a restatement of it.

## Sweep

`skills/objectstack-i18n/**` (SKILL.md, `evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`, `references/_index.md`) and every other published skill (`grep -rn resultDialog skills`) were read for any sentence the new key makes false or incomplete.

- **Hits fixed (same rule):** the two lines above — the action key row and the `translation-target-unknown` paragraph. No other skill lists the action dialog bundle keys.
- **No hit:** `references/_index.md` (generated) lists the module's exports; `ActionPreflightTranslationSchema` is module-local by design (translation.zod.ts L316–L319), so the index stays true.
- **Near misses outside this rule, left as they are:**
  - **Pre-existing, left out by seat ruling:** the paragraph's "Three more shapes under an action entry are the error" already omits two errors `checkActionEntry` raises (L2661–L2662): `submitText` under an action with no non-empty `params`, and `cancelText` under an action with neither `confirmText` nor `params` (both `translation-target-unknown`, L2677 and L2703). The row names `submitText`'s host but not `cancelText` at all (the key exists, `translation.mdx` L136). Pre-existing and not about `preflight`; worth its own card.
  - `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` L24 teaches `preflight` itself (PR #32088) and does not point at the bundle key; that file is outside this card's surface.

## The eval case

**Surface widening (seat ruling):** the first report said no existing case fitted (case 1 is the only one touching `_actions`, a whole-object scaffold asserting `label` only). The seat (domain:skills#3) then widened this card's surface to `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/*.json` for one new case in case 8's "still English" shape. The claim stands with that widening.

`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` gains case 10:

- Prompt: in zh-CN the `crm_renew` action on `crm_opportunity` opens its param dialog with the pre-submit read's rows still in English; its `preflight.fields` declares `amount` and `verdict.summary`.
- Expected: `objects.crm_opportunity._actions.crm_renew.preflight.fields`, keyed by each declared literal `path` (`'verdict.summary'` is one key, never nested), each value the label string with no `.label`; nothing else under `preflight`, since `defineTranslationBundle` refuses any other key; an undeclared path is `translation-target-unknown`.
- `must_contain`: `_actions`, `crm_renew`, `preflight`, `fields`, `verdict.summary`. `must_not_contain`: `title:` (an invented `preflight.title`), `verdict: {` (the dotted path split into nested objects).
- Every `must_contain` string is in `expected_output` literally, and no `must_not_contain` string is. The bundle shape it expects parses through `TranslationDataSchema` (the `tsx` probe above uses the same `'verdict.summary'` key). Eval fixtures are measured, not ratcheted.

|:--|:--|:--|:--|

## Changeset

`.changeset/skills-i18n-action-preflight.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, with `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` (the key already exists; this only teaches it).

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 46 commands against merge base `7e8b31ce5`. All 46 ran on head `7336c169`, and again (all 46, after the eval case landed) on head `5bae87cb`, after `git fetch --deepen=300 origin main` and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts`, under `NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=8192`: **46 × exit 0, 0 NOT MEASURED** among the listed commands. Five of them (`check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`) exited 3 on the first pass for want of built packages; after a full `pnpm build` (exit 0, 119/119 tasks) each re-ran to exit 0. The CI-only families dispatch-gates names as not locally measurable (shard planning, Build Core steps, type-check lanes, dogfood jobs) are left to CI. Per-command records: project files `card-31925/gates-7336c169.txt` and `card-31925/gates-5bae87cb.txt` (46 × exit 0 each).
